# Method: Rényi-DP: Code includes both n=100 and n=1000

## We set set.seed(12345) for all code to ensure reproducibility in the paper submitted to JSTP. Furthermore, the for loop takes a long time to run; therefore, using cache = TRUE is highly recommended for the main chunk.


## alpha = 2
### n = 100 
```{r, cache=TRUE}
rdiscrete_gaussian <- function(n_samples, sigma) {
  round(rnorm(n_samples, mean = 0, sd = sigma))
}

sample_phat_from_grid <- function(phat_star, n, sigma) {
  grid <- seq(0, 1, by = 1 / n) 
  
  likelihoods <- exp(-((phat_star - grid)^2 * n^2) / (2 * sigma^2))
  likelihoods <- likelihoods / sum(likelihoods)
  
  sample(grid, size = 1, prob = likelihoods)
}

gibbs_sampling_grid <- function(phat_star, n, sigma, iterations) {
  p_samples <- numeric(iterations)
  p_samples[1] <- 0.5
  
  for (i in 2:iterations) {
    phat <- sample_phat_from_grid(phat_star, n, sigma)
    alpha_par <- phat * n + 1
    beta_par <- (1 - phat) * n + 1
    
    if (alpha_par > 0 && beta_par > 0) {
      p_samples[i] <- rbeta(1, alpha_par, beta_par)
    } else {
      p_samples[i] <- p_samples[i - 1]
    }
  }
  
  return(p_samples)
}

credible_interval <- function(posterior_samples, alpha = 0.05) {
  posterior_samples <- posterior_samples[!is.na(posterior_samples)]
  lower_bound <- quantile(posterior_samples, probs = alpha / 2)
  upper_bound <- quantile(posterior_samples, probs = 1 - alpha / 2)
  c(lower_bound, upper_bound)
}

n <- 100
ps <- c(0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8)
epsilons <- c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 5)
num_simulations <- 5000
iterations <- 5000
alpha <- 0.05
set.seed(12345)

bayesian_simulation_results <- list()

rdp_alpha <- 2  

for (p_true in ps) {
  for (epsilon in epsilons) {
    cat("\nProcessing: Epsilon =", epsilon, "and p =", p_true, "\n")
    
    count_in_interval <- 0
    credible_intervals <- matrix(NA, nrow = num_simulations, ncol = 2)
    
    # RDP calibration for (alpha, epsilon)-RDP with sensitivity Δ=1 on the COUNT
    sigma <- sqrt(rdp_alpha / (2 * epsilon))
    
    for (sim in 1:num_simulations) {
      k <- sum(rbinom(n, 1, p_true))
      phat <- k / n
      
      k_star <- k + rdiscrete_gaussian(1, sigma)
      k_star <- min(max(k_star, 0), n)   # keep it a valid count
      
      phat_star <- k_star / n
      
      posterior_samples <- gibbs_sampling_grid(phat_star, n, sigma, iterations)
      ci <- credible_interval(posterior_samples, alpha)
      credible_intervals[sim, ] <- ci
      
      if (p_true >= ci[1] && p_true <= ci[2]) {
        count_in_interval <- count_in_interval + 1
      }
    }
    
    bayesian_simulation_results[[paste0("Epsilon_", epsilon, "_p_", p_true)]] <- list(
      bayesian_coverage = count_in_interval / num_simulations,
      credible_intervals = credible_intervals
    )
    
    cat("Completed: Epsilon =", epsilon, "and p =", p_true, "\n")
  }
}

bayesian_coverage_results <- data.frame()
for (epsilon in epsilons) {
  for (p in ps) {
    result <- bayesian_simulation_results[[paste0("Epsilon_", epsilon, "_p_", p)]]
    bayesian_coverage <- result$bayesian_coverage
    avg_length <- mean(result$credible_intervals[, 2] - result$credible_intervals[, 1])
    lower_bound <- result$credible_intervals[1, 1]
    upper_bound <- result$credible_intervals[1, 2]
    
    bayesian_coverage_results <- rbind(
      bayesian_coverage_results,
      data.frame(Epsilon = epsilon,
                 p = p,
                 Bayesian_Coverage = bayesian_coverage,
                 Lower_Bound = lower_bound,
                 Upper_Bound = upper_bound,
                 Avg_Length = avg_length)
    )
  }
}

cat("\nBayesian Coverage, Interval Bounds, and Average Length Results:\n")
print(bayesian_coverage_results)
cat("\nExample of Detailed Results for Selected Epsilon and p:\n")
for (epsilon in c(0.1, 0.5)) {
  for (p in c(0.1, 0.5)) {
    result <- bayesian_simulation_results[[paste0("Epsilon_", epsilon, "_p_", p)]]
    avg_length <- mean(result$credible_intervals[, 2] - result$credible_intervals[, 1])
    cat("\nEpsilon =", epsilon, ", p =", p, ":\n")
    cat("Bayesian Coverage:", result$bayesian_coverage, "\n")
    cat("First Credible Interval: [", result$credible_intervals[1, 1], ", ",
        result$credible_intervals[1, 2], "]\n")
    cat("Average Length of Credible Intervals:", avg_length, "\n")
  }
}
```

```{r}
add_panel_lines <- function(plot) {
  plot +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.28),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing.x = unit(1.5, "lines"),
      panel.spacing.y = unit(1.2, "lines")
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = data.frame(x = -Inf, y = -Inf),
      aes(x = -Inf, xend = -Inf, y = -Inf, yend = Inf),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = data.frame(x = -Inf, y = -Inf),
      aes(x = -Inf, xend = Inf, y = -Inf, yend = -Inf),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.6
    )
}

plot_coverage_renyi <- ggplot(df_all, aes(x = factor(p), y = coverage, group = 1)) +
  geom_point(color = "#0072B2", size = 2, shape =11) +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(n),
    cols = vars(sigma2),
    labeller = labeller(
      n = function(x) paste0("n = ", x),
      sigma2 = function(x) paste0("σ² = ", x)
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = "True Proportion (p)", y = "Coverage (%)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank()
  )

plot_coverage_renyi <- add_panel_lines(plot_coverage_renyi)

plot_length_renyi <- ggplot(df_all, aes(x = factor(p), y = length, group = 1)) +
  geom_point(color = "#0072B2", size = 2, shape = 11) +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(n),
    cols = vars(sigma2),
    labeller = labeller(
      n = function(x) paste0("n = ", x),
      sigma2 = function(x) paste0("σ² = ", x)
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = "True Proportion (p)", y = "Interval Length") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.3f", x)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank()
  )

plot_length_renyi <- add_panel_lines(plot_length_renyi)

plot_coverage_renyi
plot_length_renyi

ggsave("RenyiDP_Coverage_n100_1000.png", plot_coverage_renyi, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 600)
ggsave("RenyiDP_Length_n100_1000.png", plot_length_renyi, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 600)
```
